usedFor: Unify holds interfaces, assistants and queries, and Google Docs keeps a written record through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Queries” in Unify, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Logging each new query in a document gives you a readable history of what was asked.

watchOut: Every Unify trigger here is polling, so a new entry appears in the document after a scheduled check.
